owner: Dr Omar Al Atrash and team
summary: An Abu Dhabi family dental clinic appears to lose new patients to a free builder address, a 2018 date and a yahoo contact.

findings.problem: The site appears to run on a free Wix address, with a Wix banner on the page.
findings.cost: Patients check a clinic's credibility online first, and a free builder address looks temporary.
findings.fix: Your own domain and a clinic email.

findings.problem: The page appears to carry a 2018 copyright date.
findings.cost: An old date tells a patient the clinic may not be active, so they book a competitor.

findings.problem: The only contact shown appears to be a yahoo address and one landline.
findings.cost: A free email gives less trust, and patients who want a quick answer have nothing faster than a call.
findings.fix: A clinic email and a one tap WhatsApp button.

findings.problem: No WhatsApp appears, and booking appears to depend on a Book Online link.
findings.cost: Patients in the UAE often message first, and a clinic that answers first wins the booking.
findings.fix: Online booking on the page and WhatsApp.

redesign: Fresh look with insurance and services.
